name: putty-knife
description: A putty knife with a broad blade, narrow neck and short handle.
useCase: Identify putty knives or surface filling and scraping tools.
misuse: Use a visible label when a tool identifies equipment, a product or an instruction.

16.reason: The wide blade narrows into one open neck above the handle.

24.reason: The larger blade and handle retain broad openings around their shared neck.
